typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	EBillPreferenceArchiveFilePath as string (),
	EBillPreferenceFilePath as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutFileName as string (),
	EBillReaderFalloutPath as string (),
	FacetsDataSource as string (),
	FacetsPassword as string (),
	FacetsUserID as string (),
	TestVaraible as string (),
	varFilePath as string ()
}

source(output(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    EPS.GRGR_ID,    EPS.SBSB_ID,    EPS.EBILL_EFF_DT,    EPS.EBILL_TERM_DT,    \'Invalid GroupId\' AS MESSAGE  FROM    AGP.GBD_EBILL_PREF_STAGE EPS     LEFT JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR ON EPS.GRGR_ID = GRGR.GRGR_ID  WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID IS NULL OR (GRGR.GRGR_ID NOT LIKE \'%SUP%\' AND GRGR.GRGR_ID NOT LIKE \'%MCR%\' AND GRGR.GRGR_ID NOT LIKE \'%PDP%\')',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> InValidGroupIDs
InValidGroupIDs sink(input(
		EBILL_EFF_DT as string,
		MESSAGE as string,
		GRGR_ID as string,
		EBILL_TERM_DT as string,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		EBILL_EFF_DT,
		MESSAGE,
		GRGR_ID,
		EBILL_TERM_DT,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> FlatFileDestination
